summary: Loader package dynamically imports sibling @sqlite-labs/createsql on require
details: index.js is a verbatim copy of the feross/buffer module with a single injected top-level statement: `var ins = import('@sqlite-labs/createsql');`. On any `require('@sqlite-labs/nodesql')`, Node dynamically loads and executes the sibling package `@sqlite-labs/createsql` in the consumer's process. The executed payload is not present in this tarball and can be rotated independently by the author. The package's identity signals diverge: the scope `@sqlite-labs` has no relationship to SQLite, the shipped code is the feross/buffer module, the author is `guilder guzman`, the linked repo is `guilderguzman/sql-link`, and the README instructs users to `npm i @sql-access/nods` (a third, unrelated name) — an impersonation shape rather than a genuine SQLite tool.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
